description: Land Title Settlement Department - Buthpitiya Mahara D/S Division, gampaha District - Cad. Map . No. 510803
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
